symptoms: You will see small white silvery patches all over the leaves.
In bad cases, the leaves start to dry out from the tip downwards.
favourable_conditions: Flooding the field helps check the population.
prevention: Keep your fields clean and free of weeds.
Use regular hoeing to disturb the soil.
Flood the infested field to reduce the number of thrips.
practices: Check five leaves per plant to count the number of nymphs and adults.
Use blue sticky traps placed 15 cm above the crop canopy to monitor them.
You can make your own traps using empty tins painted blue and coated with grease or castor oil.
